Confluence 'Errata 4' (18 Sep 2026) · NOT yet on api-specs main

The 'KYCCaptured' status is removed from the set of QuoteStatus values an LFI may set on this endpoint — going forward only the TPP may set it (to signal completed KYC capture for LFI validation). Sighted only in the Confluence Consolidated Errata page's new 'Errata 4' section (2026-09-18); the api-specs main breaking-changes registers and the OpenAPI files themselves are unchanged (0/99, all 10 tracked registers byte-identical) — not yet enforced anywhere.
No action required today (not yet published to api-specs/API Hub). Insurance LFIs should stop self-setting KYCCaptured once this is formally published.

Content-Type correction: the advertised Content-Type for webhook event delivery changes from application/jwe (not a registered media type) to application/jwt (RFC 7519). Payload format is unchanged (still a nested JWT delivered as a JWE in Compact Serialization) -- only the declared header is corrected to match wire behaviour. Separately, the Insurance Quote Event schema makes QuoteId required in Data across all quote-event status branches (aligning Data with Meta, where it was already required), and AEInsuranceResourceIdentifierType drops its uuid format constraint (relaxation, not a restriction).

No action required today (V2.2 is still draft/RC). Once V2.2 is finalised: TPPs that dispatch on the Content-Type header must accept application/jwt; LFIs emitting Insurance Quote Events must include QuoteId in the event Data body, not just Meta.
API Hub Consent Manager (uae-api-hub-consent-manager) — GET /psu/{userId}/consents, POST /consents

GET /psu/{userId}/consents' status query parameter changes from a bare string to an array of AEConsentStatus (comma-separated); an unrecognized status value, previously silently accepted (empty result), is now rejected with HTTP 400. POST /consents' Creditor/Debtor Reference schemas gain a third variant: the existing unrestricted free-text branch is marked DEPRECATED (open strings will be withdrawn in a future version) alongside the OFP-003-patterned branch already enforced in v2.1-errata3; v2.2 today still validates a strict superset of v2.1 (nothing newly rejected).

No action required today (V2.2 is still draft/RC; nothing currently valid becomes invalid). LFIs/TPPs already on the OFP-003 charset are unaffected going forward. Any integration still sending unrestricted-charset Creditor/Debtor references should plan migration ahead of the open-string branch's future removal.

fillBasisNote: Counts use Active API-family registrations in the production directory. Family presence does not prove every release-specific function works or establish regulatory compliance.

prodGrid.note: Green = capability exposed in the production Trust Framework directory AND carrying live 2xx traffic in the public logs. Blue = exposed in production but no live 2xx traffic in the window. Hatched = not exposed for that capability in the production directory. Exposure is unambiguously production (production directory); Nebras publishes no per-environment volumes, so 'live' means observed successful traffic on the capability. Payments traffic is measured on initiation, so a 5xx-only initiation flow shows blue, not green.

adoptionNote: Registration (production directory, 14 orgs, 16 Nov) and successful public-log traffic (Sep–Oct, demand-side) are separate bases. Logs omit environment, so no traffic is not non-compliance.

Production directory: ADCB registers the ATM family v2.1 Active. 3 of 8 Tier-1 banks now register ATM locations (Retail Extended Data Sharing, due Apr 2026).
Standard Chartered Bank (Retail, Tier-2) enters the API log as bank and as TPP calling itself: account information v2.1 from 3 Nov, first 2xx 9 Nov. It still registers no API resources.
First-seen TPP–bank pairing: MASHREQ BANK PSC (as TPP) → First Abu Dhabi Bank, v2.1 accounts and payments, from 29 Oct (10 2xx calls in October).
v2.2-rc2-nebras head 2b966abe (4 Nov) still contains ConsentId format uuid from 1b2f0ec (26 Oct), plus later 504 and identifier commits. Main is unchanged.
Two first-seen TPP–bank pairings in October: SPARE DIGITAL TECHNOLOGIES and WIO BANK (as TPP) now call HSBC (Retail).
First-seen identifier in the auth log: uae-adcbsme (1 call, 4xx, 23 Oct). Shown as 'ADCB SME (unconfirmed)' until verified; no API-log traffic yet.

Limitation of Liability Model v23 (28 Oct): item 17 narrowed from any 'centralized API hub and/or Trust Framework failure' to consent-mechanism or access-control failure; examples for items 1 and 3 trimmed.
Commercial and Pricing Model v35 (19 Oct): LFIs now have 3 calendar days (was 5) to patch payment status; payments still pending after 3 days earn the LFI no fee.
Website spec branch v2.2-rc2 changed structurally (21–24 Oct): aud becomes a single string in all signed families, CoP gains required AccountStatus, discovery array change reverted.
Production directory: FAB (account information) and HSBC (account information + payments) now register v2.1 Active beside v2.0; Emirates NBD registers the ATM family. Tier-1 release counts unchanged.
Staging branch api-specs/ozone (PRs #33/#34, 12–13 Oct) edits the final v2.1-errata3 insurance spec in place and withdraws five changes from v2.2-rc1. Not yet on main.
First-seen TPP–bank pairing: MASHREQ BANK PSC (as TPP) → HSBC (Retail), 4 calls on 13–14 Oct (v2.1 accounts and payments).
Payments log revised for closed months: full-month accepted value AED 288.31M → 290.08M (+1.77M, mostly May and Sep); full-month status counts also moved.
Draft insurance spec version/changelog advanced to v2.2.2 on the website branch. Main is unchanged.
Website spec branch changed main → v2.2-rc2-nebras (28 Sep). The site now shows v2.2-rc2 drafts for 10 families that are not on api-specs main.
v2.2-rc2 adds OnBehalfOf, PaymentRail and AuthorizationExpirationDateTime, a stricter date-time pattern, and a breaking CoP discovery change. No endpoints added or removed.
Production directory: a 6th Commercial Go-Live Approval dated 28 Sep. Now 5 of 8 Tier-1 banks plus 1 Tier-2 hold one. Families and versions are unchanged.
A TPP appears in the logs for the first time: MERCURY PAYMENTS SERVICES LLC (279 v1.2 account-data calls at one bank, 15-28 Sep). 5 new TPP-bank pairings in September.
Tier-2 deadlines for 8 Open Banking releases fell due Sep 2026. Only WIO (full retail set) and National Bank of Fujairah (account data) of 30 Tier-2 banks are registered.
National Bank of Fujairah (Tier-2) shows its first sandbox traffic: 148 calls as a bank, 145 as a TPP, dated 6-13 Aug (a late backfill).
Confluence 'Errata 4' (18 Sep): LFIs may no longer set QuoteStatus=KYCCaptured on insurance quote logs; only the TPP may. Not yet on GitHub or the website.
Production overlay now has 67 successful-traffic and 6 exposed-only capabilities in August–September.
Corporate full-suite mandate fell due Sep 2026 for both tiers. Corporate readiness can't be observed in the directory or the logs.
Federal Decree-Law 6/2025 has a one-year reconciliation period, with Board power to extend. Exact institution-specific obligations require separate review.
Dubai Islamic Bank full-month 4xx/5xx share is 83.9% across 104,621 calls through Oct 2026. Public logs do not identify the environment.
Orient Insurance PJSC full-month 4xx/5xx share is 72.1% across 104 calls through Oct 2026. Public logs do not identify the environment.
FAB business (unconfirmed) full-month 4xx/5xx share is 100.0% across 49 calls through Oct 2026. Public logs do not identify the environment.
Al Wathba National Insurance Co (unconfirmed) full-month 4xx/5xx share is 100.0% across 18 calls through Oct 2026. Public logs do not identify the environment.

summary.text: No spec change: main stays v2.1-final + errata3; v2.2-rc2 branch still at 4 Nov. Website adds proposal OFP-021 and documents rc2 changes §18–21.
1–10 Nov: 429,445 calls at 2.4% errors, already half of October (842,969). Full months unchanged. New: Standard Chartered self-test traffic; Mashreq-as-TPP → FAB.
Open Insurance Tier-1 rises to 3/16 (Al Ain Ahlia). A third Tier-1 bank registers the ATM family. Retail R1/R2 stay 8/8 Tier-1.
V2.2 uplift is due for Tier 1 in Dec 2026, about 15 days away. No bank or insurer registers v2.2, and V2.2 Final is not yet published.
